title: オークスの後に・主役

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've earned the title of Queen of the Oaks! I'll keep up this momentum and win the Shuka Sho, too! After all, I'm the lead star of the Tiara tour!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There may be some who shed tears in my shadow, but that won't stop me running down the path to becoming a brilliant princess! Ohohoho! Ohohoho! Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'll dazzle on stage at the concert, too! Gaze upon this Princess☆Uppercut!
